# Figures for MAS Fiscal 2017

## Values from the Annual Report

- **MASCO (2015):** $200.79 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **S&P 500 Index (2015):** $151.94 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **MASCO (2016):** $227.08 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **S&P Industrials Index (2013):** $140.18 (Source: documents/report.md)

## Ratio Calculation

The ratio of the value of the common stock MASCO to the S&P 500 Index in 2015 is:

\[ \text{Ratio} = \frac{\text{MASCO (2015)}}{\text{S&P 500 Index (2015)}} = \frac{200.79}{151.94} \approx 1.32 \]

**Source:** documents/report.md and documents/call_transcript.md

**Note:** All figures are final and audited.

# Figures for MAS Fiscal 2017

## Values from the Annual Report

- **MASCO (2015):** $200.79 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **S&P 500 Index (2015):** $151.94 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **MASCO (2016):** $227.08 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **S&P Industrials Index (2013):** $140.18 (Source: documents/report.md)

## Ratio Calculation

The ratio of the value of the common stock MASCO to the S&P 500 Index in 2015 is:

\[ \text{Ratio} = \frac{\text{MASCO (2015)}}{\text{S&P 500 Index (2015)}} = \frac{200.79}{151.94} \approx 1.32 \]

**Source:** documents/report.md and documents/call_transcript.md

**Note:** All figures are final and audited.
